purpose: One record of every campaign ordinal this project has claimed. The producer packs the ordinal into every event identifier, and the ordinal keys the seed band SEED_BASE + ordinal * CAMPAIGN_STRIDE in tools/campaign.py. A re-used ordinal therefore draws seeds another campaign has already burned and stamps event identifiers two campaigns share. Neither is correctable once the jobs have run, so tools/render_production_submit.py reads this file and refuses an ordinal held here by a different campaign, before it writes a submit file.
coverage: Ordinals 0 to 11. This file makes no claim about an ordinal outside that range, and one such claim exists in the tree: results/validation/generator/PYTHIA_JUNCTION_HANG_20260731.md records HF_GATEB_primaryGround_pilot_v8 at ordinal 26.
authority: The burned-seed ledger at HADRONIZATION_DATA_ROOT/project/runs/seed_ledgers/burned_seeds.txt stays authoritative for which seeds are spent. It lives outside every execution checkout and it records seeds rather than campaign names, so it cannot answer which campaign holds an ordinal. This file answers that. config/systematics_variations_v1.json remains the source for the systematics variations themselves, and tests/test_campaign_ordinal_registry.py cross-checks ordinals 4 to 10 against it.
uniqueness_rule: docs/PIPELINE.md requires ordinals to be unique among campaigns whose events can enter one merge, and adds the convention that a new campaign takes a distinct ordinal. The legacy rows below predate that convention: ordinal 1 carries three campaigns, none of which merges with another.
date_note: `claimed` is the earliest date this repository can evidence for the claim. It is not always the date the campaign ran: the history before the 2026-08-22 rebuild is not in this repository, so the legacy rows carry on-or-before dates and `claimed_evidence` names exactly what establishes each one.

ordinals.scope: No campaign ever declared this ordinal. seed_derivation_v1 carried no campaign term, so every campaign rendered before seed_derivation_v2 drew from SEED_BASE, which is the ordinal-0 band; tools/campaign.py records that derivation and the collision it caused. The band is spent and no campaign may draw it again.
